guanglei-zhou.name: Dr. Guanglei Zhou (周光磊 博士)
guanglei-zhou.affiliation: Institute of Geotechnical Engineering, BOKU University
guanglei-zhou.summary: Focuses on rock mechanics, thermo-hydro-mechanical (THM) coupled processes, and the stability of underground excavations and energy storage caverns.
interests: Thermo-hydro-mechanical (THM) coupling behavior of jointed rock masses
Crack initiation, propagation, and coalescence in heterogeneous rocks
Geomechanical stability of underground excavations and deep energy storage caverns
Numerical simulation of damage evolution in brittle and soft rocks

lingfeng-guo.affiliation: Institute of Geotechnical Engineering, BOKU University

interests: Multiscale constitutive modeling of granular media and soil fabric evolution
Soil-structure interaction and geotechnical stability under environmental loadings
European research projects (LOC3G / MONUGEO) hosted at BOKU IGT

xinying-han.name: Xinying Han (韩心莹)
xinying-han.affiliation: Institute of Geotechnical Engineering, BOKU University
xinying-han.summary: Doctoral researcher investigating phase-field modeling of desiccation-induced cracking and moisture-suction coupling in unsaturated geomaterials.
interests: Phase-field modeling of desiccation-induced cracking in unsaturated soils
